text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer developed paragraphs with examples for sports, book clubs, and community service","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay explains its points with multiple supporting examples and elaborations rather than relying on brief statements."},{"evidence":"varied transitions like \"Also,\" \"Well,\" \"In conclusion\"","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay uses clearer linking words and sectioning to guide the reader through its argument."},{"evidence":"\"helps others, it also helps you\"; \"not only helps others\"","quality":"sentence complexity","description":"The essay shows more control of multi-clause sentence structures and combinations of related ideas."},{"evidence":"\"doing community service not only helps others, it also helps you!\"","quality":"persuasive elaboration","description":"The essay more fully develops reasons for its claim by explaining benefits in a convincing way."},{"evidence":"\"around the world even places that dont even exist\"; \"something really interesting and fun\"","quality":"expressive vocabulary","description":"The essay uses a somewhat wider range of descriptive and engaging word choices to add detail and emphasis."}]}
